items.text: Housing is essential to improve the health and wellness of children and adults. We must continue to fight for the opportunity to invest in housing resources – like rental assistance, public housing, and the Housing Trust Fund. It’s time to #BuildBackBetter
Last week, I had the opportunity to participate in a nutrition roundtable to discuss how tribal communities are disproportionately affected by food insecurity. (1/3) https://t.co/t2zQCDZtfb

We need to provide our Tribal communities the necessary resources for a New Mexico traditional meal. I called on @POTUS to Convene a National @WhiteHouse Conference on Food, Nutrition, Hunger, and Health https://t.co/i2gtTANmST

Translation: Republicans voted to raise  premiums and kick 4.2 million Americans off the Affordable Care Act, and they meant it. 

Remember, higher premium notices go out in November. 

This is solely on Republicans. 

Democrats are not backing down from the fight to restore healthcare for Americans

Millions across the country are facing higher ACA premiums under the proposed Republican short term funding bill. 

Republicans on the Rules Committee had the chance to stop it today by accepting commonsense amendments — but they refused. Instead, they chose to play partisan games at the expense of the American people.

Trump just walked away from bipartisan negotiations to fund the government — with only 8 days left before a shutdown.

The Senate has already rejected his party’s reckless, partisan spending bill that locks in higher premiums for millions and massive cuts to the health care system.

Republicans control Washington. The ball is in their court.

Trump’s health care cuts are already closing rural hospitals, spiking premiums, and could strip coverage from 15 million Americans.

Trump and Republicans have created a healthcare crisis that will only get worse if they shut down the government this week. 

I’m fighting to extend lower ACA premiums—but I need your stories.

📩 Share them: https://t.co/O0trrZVrrL

Trump broke the law and fired dedicated federal workers from the beginning and is threatening to do more unless we go along with their plan to cut your health care and raise your premiums.  

I’m not going along, I’m fighting back against all of it.
